_comment: Events at sea: weather, the sea itself, strangers and wreckage. See docs/events.md.

man_overboard.title: Man overboard!
man_overboard.text: A green sea sweeps the waist and takes {sailor} with it. Still afloat, waving, falling astern fast.

choices.text: Heave to and lower a boat
choices.result: They haul {sailor} in half-drowned. The crew saw you turn back for one of their own.
choices.fail_result: The boat searches until dark. The sea keeps {sailor}.

choices.result: {sailor} catches the line and is dragged aboard like a gaffed fish.
choices.fail_result: The line falls short.

choices.result: Nobody speaks at mess that night.

becalmed.title: Becalmed
becalmed.text: The wind dies to nothing. The sails hang slack, the pitch bubbles in the deck seams, and the water casks go down by the hour.

choices.text: Put the boats out and tow
choices.result: Backbreaking work at the oars, but she creeps on.

choices.text: Wait it out and ration the water
choices.result: Three days of glass-flat sea before a cat's-paw ruffles the water.

choices.text: Whistle for a wind (the old sailors swear by it)
choices.result: A breeze comes up by the afternoon watch. The superstitious are delighted.
choices.fail_result: Nothing. Four days of it.

flotsam_cask.title: Flotsam
flotsam_cask.text: The lookout spots casks bobbing in the swell, the wreck of somebody's cargo.

choices.result: Sound casks of {good}, salt-stained but good.

choices.text: Leave them: a wreck means reefs or pirates nearby
choices.result: You keep a sharp lookout instead.

castaways.title: Castaways
castaways.text: A ragged figure on a sandbar waves a shirt on a stick. Through the glass: three, four men, burnt black by the sun.

choices.text: Take them aboard and sign them on
choices.result: {newcomer} and the others weep at the sight of water. They'll work for nothing but their keep.

choices.text: Take them aboard, put them ashore at the next port
choices.result: They bless your name to anyone who'll listen.

choices.text: Sail on. Marooned men are marooned for a reason
choices.result: Their shouts carry a long way over the water.

st_elmos_fire.title: St. Elmo's fire
st_elmos_fire.text: Pale blue flames dance on the yardarms and mastheads. Some of the men cross themselves; {sailor} swears it's the souls of drowned sailors come to take another.

choices.text: Tell them it's a blessing: the saint watches over us
choices.result: The fear turns to wonder.
choices.fail_result: Nobody believes you. They mutter about ill omens all night.

choices.text: Order silence and get on with the work
choices.result: Work goes on, fire or no fire.
choices.fail_result: {sailor} has half the watch convinced the ship is doomed.

squall_carries_away.title: White squall
squall_carries_away.text: A squall comes out of a clear sky. Before the topsails can come in, the fore-topmast goes with a crack like a cannon shot.

choices.result: Axes flash. The wreckage goes over the side before it can stave in the hull.

choices.text: Try to save the spars and rigging
choices.result: Hard, dangerous work, but your carpenter saves most of it.
choices.fail_result: The wreckage swings into the side and takes a man with it.

waterspout.title: Waterspout
waterspout.text: A dark column of whirling water marches across the sea toward you, sucking up spray.

choices.result: It passes half a cable off your quarter.
choices.fail_result: It clips you: sails blown out, a boat smashed.

choices.text: Fire a gun into it (the old cure)
choices.result: The ball goes through and the spout collapses in a great rain. The men cheer.
choices.fail_result: Miss. It comes on regardless.

whale.title: Whales
whale.text: A pod of whales surfaces alongside, blowing and rolling, close enough to touch.

choices.result: For an hour nobody thinks about pay or rum.

choices.text: Try for one with a harpoon
choices.result: Two days flensing, but you'll eat well and there's oil to sell.
choices.fail_result: The whale sounds and nearly takes the boat down with it.

rain_squall_water.title: Rain
rain_squall_water.text: A heavy tropical rain comes down like a curtain.

choices.text: Spread the sails and fill every cask
choices.result: Fresh water, sweet as wine after the green stuff in the casks.

fish_shoal.title: A shoal of fish
fish_shoal.text: The sea boils with fish. Dolphins and flying fish leap all around the bow.

choices.result: A day's fishing fills the kettles.
The cook looks longingly astern.

drifting_longboat.title: A drifting longboat
drifting_longboat.text: A longboat drifts on the swell. In it, a {nation_adj} officer and two seamen, half-dead. Their ship went down three days ago.

choices.text: Take them aboard and land them in a {nation_adj} port
choices.result: The officer promises the governor will hear of this.

choices.text: Take them aboard and offer the officer a berth
choices.result: {officer} has nothing to go back to and signs on.
Their families pay, eventually.
The longboat falls astern.

fouled_water.title: The water has turned
fouled_water.text: The surgeon reports green slime in the water casks. Men who drank it are already sick.

choices.result: Half your water goes over the side. Better than the flux.
It tastes vile, but nobody else falls sick.
choices.fail_result: The flux goes through the lower deck. Two men die of it.

rats_in_hold.title: Rats
rats_in_hold.text: The bread room is crawling with rats. They've been at the stores for weeks.

choices.result: A day of choking smoke below decks. The rats are gone, and so is a share of the bread.

choices.text: Offer a tot of rum for every rat's tail
choices.result: A great hunt. The ship's boys make a fortune in rum.

sprung_leak.title: Sprung a leak
sprung_leak.text: The well is sounded: three feet of water in the hold, and rising. A plank has sprung somewhere below the waterline.

choices.text: Find it and fother it with a sail
choices.result: A sail drawn under the hull plugs the leak.
choices.fail_result: The pumps run day and night until you can patch her properly.

choices.result: Exhausting, but she stays afloat.

fog_bank.title: Fog
fog_bank.text: Thick fog rolls in. Somewhere close, a ship's bell is ringing.

choices.text: Ring your own bell and hail her
choices.result: A {nation_adj} merchantman. You trade news across the water and part friends.

choices.text: Creep up on her in silence
choices.result: Her hull looms out of the murk, close enough to board.
The bell fades.

message_in_bottle.title: A bottle in the sea
message_in_bottle.text: The boatswain fishes a corked bottle out of the sea. Inside: a scrap of chart, a cross, and the words 'Twenty paces from the twin palms, {port}'.

choices.text: Keep it. Next time you're in {port}, you'll look
choices.result: You fold the scrap carefully into your coat.
Some joker's idea of fun, surely.

reef_ahead.title: Breakers ahead!
reef_ahead.text: The lookout screams 'Breakers!' A reef the chart doesn't show, dead ahead.

choices.result: She clears it by a fathom. The navigator corrects the chart with shaking hands.
choices.fail_result: She strikes, grinds, and comes off with planks stove in.

choices.result: The anchor bites. You warp off in the morning.
choices.fail_result: The anchor drags.

yellow_flag.title: The yellow flag
yellow_flag.text: A merchantman lies hove to with a yellow flag at the masthead: plague, or yellow fever. A voice begs for a surgeon.

choices.result: Your surgeon saves most of them, and comes back clean.
choices.fail_result: The fever comes back with your surgeon. Three of your men die of it.

choices.text: Send over food and water, no more
choices.result: They cheer you from the rail.
You've seen what fever does to a ship.

dead_calm_sharks.title: Sharks
dead_calm_sharks.text: Sharks circle the ship. {sailor} dares the others to swim under the keel.

choices.result: {sailor} sulks for days.

choices.text: Let them. A bet's a bet
choices.result: {sailor} comes up the other side grinning. The legend of {sailor} grows.
choices.fail_result: The water turns red.

hurricane_signs.title: A long swell from the east
hurricane_signs.text: A long greasy swell, a brassy sky, birds flying west. The old hands say a hurricane is coming.

choices.result: You lose two days sheltering in a lee. Nothing comes of it, this time.

choices.text: Strike the topmasts, double the lashings, carry on
choices.result: The blow, when it comes, passes to the north.
choices.fail_result: It catches you in the open. You survive, barely.

abandoned_ship.title: A ship with no one aboard
abandoned_ship.text: A {nation_adj} brigantine drifts with her sails in rags. No one answers your hail. The galley fire is cold; the table is laid for dinner.

choices.result: Her hold is full of {good}. The men are uneasy; nobody wants to sleep near the things they brought back.

choices.text: Board her, and search for the reason
choices.result: A log, a mutiny, a captain's strongbox they never found. Now you have.
choices.fail_result: A rotten deck gives way under a boarder.

choices.text: Sink her. Some things should stay lost
choices.result: The superstitious approve.

lightning_strike.title: Lightning
lightning_strike.text: A bolt strikes the mainmast. Smoke pours from the top; the tar in the rigging is alight.

choices.result: Buckets and wet canvas. It's out.
choices.fail_result: The mainsail burns before it's out.

choices.result: Safe, if the powder's soaked. The fire burns itself out in the rigging.

spanish_coastguard.title: Guarda costa
spanish_coastguard.text: A Spanish guarda costa runs out from the coast and hails you: heave to and be searched for contraband.

choices.text: Heave to and let them look
choices.result: Bribes, paperwork and a good deal of shrugging. They leave empty-handed.
choices.fail_result: They find enough to fine you heavily.

choices.result: She's fast.
You run out your guns.

pirate_signal.title: A signal from the shore
pirate_signal.text: Smoke on a headland: two columns, then one. The Brethren's sign for 'Fat prize passing'.

choices.result: A {nation_adj} merchantman, just where the smoke said.

choices.text: Leave the prize to whoever lit the fire
choices.result: Manners among thieves.

navy_impress.title: Pressed men
navy_impress.text: A {nation_adj} man-of-war orders you to heave to. Her lieutenant wants seamen for the King's service, and he means to take some of yours.

choices.result: Four of your best are rowed away.
He backs down, with bad grace.
choices.fail_result: He takes five, and the best of them.

choices.result: He finds one old man and gives up.
choices.fail_result: He finds them, and is not amused.
